data.body: EVIDENCE / RESOLUTION: implemented the ratified option (b) richer probe contract. Gerrit change 2129, merged to main as b392d7369d64f4f258eb5e94859dcfb62146d0e2 with LLM-Review +1 (PASS) and Verified +1 (CI SUCCESS: run 32603295594). Acceptance verified: (1) _JiraProbePort.issue_link_types() now degrades a failed read to None (could not check), distinct from a checked-and-empty [] — RED-first test test_real_port_link_types_failure_is_none_not_empty; (2) doctor's _drift_findings degrades a None link axis to ONE distinct per-axis 'could not check' unavailable finding (new kind mapping-drift-axis-unavailable, rendered 'mapping unavailable: live mapping-drift check could not check the link axis: ...'), never as drift and never silently dropped, while status/type axes are still diffed — test_link_probe_failure_degrades_link_axis_not_drift; (3) a link-types failure alone never blocks (test_link_probe_failure_alone_is_not_blocking); (4) a genuinely-empty observed link vocabulary still drifts, guarding the empty-vs-failed distinction (test_genuinely_empty_link_vocabulary_still_drifts); (5) suggest-mapping's builder stays fail-soft (None folds to an empty optional axis — test_builder_tolerates_link_types_could_not_check). Gates: make lint, make typecheck, complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0, targeted suites 33/33 pass. Root cause blame: the fail-soft [] degradation was introduced with the probe port itself (ad81-73ad-83bb-47c7, 'Live Jira probe to pre-populate mapping config'); the S10 doctor consumer merely exposed the latent ambiguity.
